description_en: It can quickly and accurately detect key fields on the ICP filing credential for Class II medical device business operations, including the filing number, company name, registered address, business premises, warehouse address, business model, legal representative, enterprise owner, business scope, license validity period, and filing date
description_zh: 可快速精准的识别第二类医疗器械经营备案凭证所包含备案编号、企业名称、住所、经营场所、库房地址、经营方式、法定代表人、企业负责人、经营范围、许可期限、备案日期等关键字段信息
kebab_example: aliyun ocr-api recognize-ctwo-medical-device-manage-license --url https://img.alicdn.com/tfs/TB1Hyx0MEH1gK0jSZSyXXXtlpXa-750-1000.png --biz-body '图片二进制文件' --region cn-hangzhou
name: RecognizeCtwoMedicalDeviceManageLicense

parameters.help_en:
This field and the body field are mutually exclusive. You must specify one and only one; they cannot both be passed through or both be empty.
Image URL (must not exceed 2048 bytes in length; base64 is not supported)
parameters.help_zh:
本字段和body字段二选一，不可同时透传或同时为空。
图片链接（长度不超2048字节，不支持base64）
parameters.name: url

parameters.help_en:
This field and the URL field are mutually exclusive. You must specify one and only one; they cannot both be passed through or both be empty.
Binary file of the image, up to 10 MB in size.
When using HTTP invocation, upload the binary image file in the HTTP body.
When using the software development kit (SDK), place the image in the SDK body
parameters.help_zh:
本字段和URL字段二选一，不可同时透传或同时为空。
图片二进制文件，最大10MB。
使用HTTP方式调用，把图片二进制文件放到HTTP body中上传即可。
使用SDK的方式调用，把图片放到SDK的body中即可
parameters.name: body
